title: Petition by the Commonwealth Gas Company, pursuant to G.L. c. 164, § 14, for approval and authorization to issue and sell up to 450,000 shares of common capital stock, $25 par value at not less than par; to issue and sell on a negotiated basis additional first Mortgage Bonds in the aggregate principal amount of up to $50,000,000 to be sold at par; for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. c. 164, § 15; and for such other action as may be deemed necessary or appropriate in connection with the foregoing.
